items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1960-07-14
items.q: I think he used to do arranging for Eddie Guchin at one time if I'm not mistaken.

ctx.x: What happened to him? He's gone.

Oh, well he's up north. I think I asked somebody about him and they said that they had met him and that he was still doing arranging. I think he used to do arranging for Eddie Guchin at one time if I'm not mistaken.
He does a lot of stocks too. Yeah. He played a few of them. Yeah. A lot of all that kind of stuff.
